verdict.rationale: telli documents a public REST API for managing contacts, scheduling calls and importing phone numbers. Calls authenticate with a bearer API key, and a probe confirmed the OpenAPI spec is live, which supplies machine-readable context for coding agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and evidence of API coverage beyond the few documented endpoints (e.g. agent configuration).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
All endpoints authenticate with an API key from the telli app (Settings > Developer), sent as a bearer token
give coding agents machine-readable API context
Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window.
